what: No application source files required modification for this remediation.
Operational cleanup only: prune aged completion reports in completion-reports/ per task instruction.
verify: find completion-reports/ -name "COMPLETION-*" | wc -l returns count under 500.
Quality gates: npm run build, npm run lint, npm test, npm audit --audit-level=high all exit 0.
boundaries: Do not modify business logic, routes, services, schema, or migrations.
Do not alter infrastructure configuration (Tailscale serve, dashboard server ports, launchd).
Do not touch unrelated untracked files present in workspace.

rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: Quality gate 'completion_reports' failed when completion report count exceeded hard limit (historical observed error: 503 max 500).
rootCauseAnalysis.why: Retention was not applied before gate evaluation, allowing completion artifact volume to grow past threshold.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Applied retention cleanup command and reran completion report retention script; current count reduced to 400 and completion_reports gate now passes in quality audit.
